text: In Odoo's Sales app, create a new quotation (New Quotation). Set the Customer to 'fwod79-n1 Bench Customer' — this is an autocomplete dropdown, so type the name and actually click the matching option from the dropdown. Then in the Order Lines table add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the product catalogue by typing in the product cell and clicking an option from the autocomplete dropdown (e.g. a real product like a desk or cabinet). Set the quantity to 3. Do NOT add any other line. Do not confirm the quotation yet — leave it as a draft quotation. Report: (1) the product name you chose, (2) the unit price the app auto-filled for that line, (3) the untaxed amount (Untaxed Amount) the app computes, and (4) the quotation's name/reference shown in the breadcrumb or title.
